photo.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor · Hohmann transfer orbit diagram. The textbook minimum-ΔV transfer between two coplanar circular orbits — one ellipse, tangent to the inner orbit at periapsis, tangent to the outer at apoapsis. Two burns, total — what every Mars-class spacecraft trajectory starts from.
